svg.title: Transport actions and site semantics
svg.desc: The common transport is a lazy mixture of a one-step operator and a mass-corrected truncated resolvent. Shared blocks use their frozen update. GPS and linear-aggregation GINE-style plants distinguish native aggregation sites from parameter-free inserted sites: A0 is native mean aggregation at the former and identity at the latter. A8 and A9 are direct state assignments. The action table gives the common-coordinate coefficients, expected hops, identity coefficient and exploration propensity; these values are read from the registered constants.

text.font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
text.tspan: Transport actions and the site they act on

text.font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
text.tspan: Ordinary transport and direct state restoration have different execution semantics.
